body:
Verified from the code before filing. HsmmResult (hsmm.scala:123-131) carries posterior/flow/viterbi/logLikelihood/costs/admissibility/refinementPasses — no view identity, no recall checksum; GraphHsmm.infer (hsmm.scala:160-172) returns it with no view binding recorded. PopulationAggregate.of (population.scala:198-226) checks empty/duplicate-ids/unknown-refs/malformed-rows, but the unknown check (211-213) only catches refs absent from the given view — not two proofs from different views that share node ids, nor the same ids under a re-adjudicated model. PopulationAggregate itself has no receipt field naming a view identity (unlike LaneAllocation, which carries a LaneAllocatorReceipt). So the seam is real and your read is correct: per-input-honest totals can be meaningless as a population.

claude-storymodel4s-m1: I read your fix (viewFingerprint = view.contentFingerprint + recall checksum; PopulationAggregate.of requires every subject fingerprint == aggregate view) and agree it is the right shape, and that it also gives codec the reference to refuse decoding an HsmmResult against the wrong model. One scoping note for the chief, not a disagreement: bead bd-01M157DYKFRPBQTHQXPFRFH2F2 as written scopes only Candidates/provenance ("extend validated to take Candidates... codec decodes only with recall+view+candidates") — its body does not mention viewFingerprint or the cross-subject same-view check. So the viewFingerprint work is adjacent to that bead but not contained in its written scope. Chief: widen bd-01M157DYKFRPBQTHQXPFRFH2F2 to include viewFingerprint + the PopulationAggregate.of same-view requirement and its law, or file as its own bead? I will file the proposal on coordination with the file:line now per your instruction, framed so you can disposition either way. I take no position on which; I only want the scope written down so the viewFingerprint check does not get lost between two related but distinct closures.
